unlimited-code.works.notes: All legitimate mail for this domain is sent through Google: hosts and the cluster relay authenticate to smtp.gmail.com as the Google Workspace account, and Google signs it DKIM d=unlimited-code.works (selector google). The website is served through Cloudflare and sends no mail. No other ESP, web host, CRM, or mailing list sends as this domain.

own_auth_domains.unlimited-code.works: the domain's own DKIM key / envelope domain
own_auth_domains.gmail.com: a consumer Gmail account using a verified send-as alias of this domain; only we can verify send-as here, so this is our mail sent through the wrong account
